E_aggregated.action_count_comment: No official tool list for the supplied endpoint was found in Booking.com pages or the evidence folder. APIs.io lists two tools: execute and describe-tools; both are included as third-party because their names were not confirmed in an official source. APIs.io also lists six documentation functions callable through execute; these are not MCP tool names. Anthropic's Claude directory lists one tool, accommodations_search, at a different Booking.com endpoint, https://demandapi-mcp.booking.com/v1/mcp/8132308, so it is not included. Booking.com's official MCP implementation guide documents a separate Demand API endpoint and names six example tool names, explicitly noting the account list can differ.

contradictions: The supplied endpoint is https://developers.booking.com/mcp, while Booking.com's official current MCP guide documents https://demandapi-mcp.booking.com/v1/sp/mcp/ and a separate affiliate-ID endpoint. These have different hosts, purposes, and access requirements; the official Demand API tool examples are not included in this endpoint's action list.

Anthropic's Claude connector directory lists accommodations_search for https://demandapi-mcp.booking.com/v1/mcp/8132308, while APIs.io lists execute and describe-tools for developers.booking.com/mcp. The available evidence identifies different endpoints, so this is a server-identity difference rather than a tool-list disagreement for one endpoint.

The prepared links_check.txt records HTTP 405 for the endpoint, whereas supplied OAuth evidence reports HTTP 500 for a POST and the input reports a separate initialize check returned HTTP 200. The observations used different requests or times; endpoint availability is therefore inconsistent across probes.
observations_for_research: The supplied global URL is associated in the catalogue with documentation discovery, while Booking.com's documented Demand API MCP is credentialed and affiliate-configured. Similar vendor branding does not mean the endpoints expose the same product surface.

The catalogue describes agent workflow instructions in the tool listing, while official documentation for the separate Demand API endpoint says its live tools/list response is authoritative and varies by affiliate configuration.
